descriptionChirho: The Hebrew proper name Ethan (אֵיתָן as a personal name, 'Ethan II' to distinguish from the adjective), referring primarily to Ethan the Ezrahite renowned for wisdom (1 Kings 4:31, Psalm 89 title), and also to Levitical figures in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles. All 8 occurrences denote the same proper noun across syntactic frames: nominative (eng: Eitan/Ethan, arb: إيثان, kor: 에단, swa: Ethani), with lamed 'of Ethan' (arb: لِإيثَانَ, hin: के–लिए–एतान), and with min 'than Ethan' (arb: مِنْ–إِيثَانَ, swa: kuliko–Ethani).
